{{Quote|He swore fealty to Darth Nyriss a dozen years ago when she led an Imperial force into his sector to subdue a potential uprising.|Sechel, about Ugroth|<ref name="Revan" />}}
A [[Realspace/Legends|space]] '''sector''' was under the rule of [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Ugroth]]<ref name="Revan" /> by around [[3966 BBY/Legends|3966 BBY]]. Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="date">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'' indicates that the events depicted in the first part of the novel take place two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the end of the [[Jedi Civil War]]. ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates the end of the war to [[3956 BBY]], equating the aforementioned section to [[3954 BBY]]. As ''The Old Republic: Revan'' dates the sector's [[Subjugation of Ugroth's sector|subjugation]] to a dozen years before the first part of the novel, the event must have occurred around [[3966 BBY/Legends|3966 BBY]].</ref> the resurgent [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] dispatched an [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial force]] under the command of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Nyriss]] to [[Subjugation of Ugroth's sector|conquer]] the region and subdue a potential uprising. At the [[Time/Legends|time]], Ugroth swore fealty to Nyriss, and Nyriss received a commemorative bust of Ugroth that she displayed in her [[Darth Nyriss's stronghold|residence]]. Her attaché, [[Sechel]], later told the visiting Sith Lord [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] about Ugroth's sector while explaining the history of the artifacts in Nyriss' stronghold.<ref name="Revan" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ugroth's sector was first mentioned in [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''.<ref name="Revan" />
